scope: Selected immutable JSON execution/review/cleanup receipts plus task documents. Every execution retains its own recorded candidate and configuration. This manifest excludes itself.
omitted_local_material: Raw logs, traces, screenshots, intermediary source inventories and binary/dependency trees
Swift compiler/module caches created during read-only protocol inspection
All .omx/private orchestration, credentials and execution configuration
Large research JSON and provenance trees outside this selected manifest
local_evidence_policy: All omitted files remain at their original local paths. No old failure, hash, exit status or clearance was rewritten. A referenced path is not proof that its raw file is included in Git.

validation.credential_pattern_scan: No JWT, native Multica/provider tokens, private keys or credentialed PostgreSQL/Redis URLs found in selected documents.
validation.structured_sensitive_fields: Only task meta.authorization prose matched the sensitive-field name scan; inspected as authorization history, not a credential.
validation.staged_diff_check: pass after task-document trailing blank-line cleanup
